title: Perfetto：非同步區間聯集與量測窗口
titleEn: Perfetto: asynchronous interval unions and observation windows
subcategoryTitle: 量測方法與科學成果驗收
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「Perfetto：非同步區間聯集與量測窗口」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付slice.csv、裁切與合併中間表、ns→ms換算及十格核對圖；保留排除的不完整slice及其影響範圍。
summaryEn: Investigate Perfetto: asynchronous interval unions and observation windows using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver raw slices, clipping and merge intermediates, nanosecond conversion and the ten-cell check. Retain incomplete excluded slices and explain which portion of the conclusion they leave uncertain.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「辨識slice與排程證據」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Distinguish slices from scheduling evidence: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 查詢join重複slice、時鐘域混用或缺少結束時間，都可能產生超過100%的假占比；負duration不能自動當零長度事件。
先證明唯一slice ID、共同時間基準與完整窗口，再報活躍聯集占比90%或100%；這不推論CPU忙碌率，也不表示任務結果正確。
PerfettoSQL把trace中的slice、track與時間欄位提供給查詢；本課從合成非同步區間計算至少一項任務活躍的時間，不把應用slice當CPU排程。
optionsEn: Duplicate slices introduced by joins, mixed clock domains or missing end times can produce false occupancy above one hundred percent. A negative or incomplete duration must not silently become a valid zero-length interval.

Require unique slice IDs, a common time basis and a complete window before reporting active-union shares of ninety or one hundred percent. These values establish neither CPU busy percentage nor correctness of task outputs.

PerfettoSQL exposes slices, tracks and timing fields for analysis. This case computes time with at least one selected asynchronous task active; application slices are not automatically evidence of CPU scheduling or utilization.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. PerfettoSQL exposes slices, tracks and timing fields for analysis. This case computes time with at least one selected asynchronous task active; application slices are not automatically evidence of CPU scheduling or utilization. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Each slice appears once with a common clock basis; the metric is labeled active-union time rather than CPU utilization.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: PerfettoSQL把trace中的slice、track與時間欄位提供給查詢；本課從合成非同步區間計算至少一項任務活躍的時間，不把應用slice當CPU排程。
knowledge.textEn: PerfettoSQL exposes slices, tracks and timing fields for analysis. This case computes time with at least one selected asynchronous task active; application slices are not automatically evidence of CPU scheduling or utilization.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用原創合成資料研究「Perfetto：非同步區間聯集與量測窗口」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付slice.csv、裁切與合併中間表、ns→ms換算及十格核對圖；保留排除的不完整slice及其影響範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate Perfetto: asynchronous interval unions and observation windows using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver raw slices, clipping and merge intermediates, nanosecond conversion and the ten-cell check. Retain incomplete excluded slices and explain which portion of the conclusion they leave uncertain.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 同一時鐘域的半開區間先裁到觀察窗口，再取聯集；直接加duration會重複計算重疊。聯集長度不能超過窗口，跨track同時活躍仍只算一次。
knowledge.textEn: Clip half-open intervals from a common clock domain to the observation window, then form their union. Summed durations double-count overlaps. Union length cannot exceed the window, even when tasks on several tracks are active simultaneously.

stages.title: 辨識slice與排程證據
stages.description: 為三個任務分配不同track及唯一slice ID，明列ns單位；查詢只選本課任務，再解釋為何要看CPU排程需另外的sched資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Assign distinct tracks and stable slice IDs to the tasks and record nanosecond units. Select only the declared tasks, then explain why a CPU scheduling conclusion would require scheduling-table evidence rather than these application annotations alone.
